differences.what: B's backdrop and sweep are a clean warm white (about 230 at the top); A's is a cool grey-blue (about 211, blue-tinted), so A reads dull and underexposed on a white homepage
B's cast shadows are darker and sharper-edged with more contrast, giving the units weight on the floor; A's are softer, lighter and greyer, so the products float and look flatter
The coloured caustics in B's shadows are more saturated and more cleanly separated (red, yellow, blue), which sells the tinted clear bodies; in A they are washed out by the grey floor
B adds a specular streak across the black horn that shows its glossy curvature; A's black horn is a flat dark shape with no form
B's chrome port tubes and bowl rims catch brighter highlights against the warmer light, so the metal reads as metal; in A they are muted grey
